005package org.wpilib.util.protobuf;
006
007import java.lang.reflect.Array;
008import java.util.ArrayList;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.function.BiConsumer;
011import java.util.function.Predicate;
012import us.hebi.quickbuf.Descriptors.Descriptor;
013import us.hebi.quickbuf.Descriptors.FileDescriptor;
014import us.hebi.quickbuf.ProtoMessage;
015import us.hebi.quickbuf.RepeatedDouble;
016import us.hebi.quickbuf.RepeatedMessage;
017
018/**
019 * Interface for Protobuf serialization.
020 *
021 * <p>This is designed for serialization of more complex data structures including forward/backwards
022 * compatibility and repeated/nested/variable length members, etc. Serialization and deserialization
023 * code is auto-generated from .proto interface descriptions (the MessageType generic parameter).
024 *
025 * <p>Idiomatically, classes that support protobuf serialization should provide a static final
026 * member named "proto" that provides an instance of an implementation of this interface, or a
027 * static final method named "getProto" if the class is generic.
028 *
029 * @param <T> object type
030 * @param <MessageType> protobuf message type
031 */
032public interface Protobuf<T, MessageType extends ProtoMessage<?>> {
033  /**
034   * Gets the Class object for the stored value.
035   *
036   * @return Class
037   */
038  Class<T> getTypeClass();
039
040  /**
041   * Gets the type string (e.g. for NetworkTables). This should be globally unique and start with
042   * "proto:".
043   *
044   * @return type string
045   */
046  default String getTypeString() {
047    return "proto:" + getDescriptor().getFullName();
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Gets the protobuf descriptor.
052   *
053   * @return descriptor
054   */
055  Descriptor getDescriptor();
056
057  /**
058   * Creates protobuf message.
059   *
060   * @return protobuf message
061   */
062  MessageType createMessage();
063
064  /**
065   * Deserializes an object from a protobuf message.
066   *
067   * @param msg protobuf message
068   * @return New object
069   */
070  T unpack(MessageType msg);
071
072  /**
073   * Copies the object contents into a protobuf message. Implementations should call either
074   * msg.setMember(member) or member.copyToProto(msg.getMutableMember()) for each member.
075   *
076   * @param msg protobuf message
077   * @param value object to serialize
078   */
079  void pack(MessageType msg, T value);
080
081  /**
082   * Updates the object contents from a protobuf message. Implementations should call
083   * msg.getMember(member), MemberClass.makeFromProto(msg.getMember()), or
084   * member.updateFromProto(msg.getMember()) for each member.
085   *
086   * <p>Immutable classes cannot and should not implement this function. The default implementation
087   * throws UnsupportedOperationException.
088   *
089   * @param out object to update
090   * @param msg protobuf message
091   * @throws UnsupportedOperationException if the object is immutable
092   */
093  default void unpackInto(T out, MessageType msg) {
094    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("object does not support unpackInto");
095  }
096
097  /**
098   * Returns whether or not objects are immutable. Immutable objects must also be comparable using
099   * the equals() method. Default implementation returns false.
100   *
101   * @return True if object is immutable
102   */
103  default boolean isImmutable() {
104    return false;
105  }
106
107  /**
108   * Returns whether or not objects are cloneable using the clone() method. Cloneable objects must
109   * also be comparable using the equals() method. Default implementation returns false.
110   *
111   * @return True if object is cloneable
112   */
113  default boolean isCloneable() {
114    return false;
115  }
116
117  /**
118   * Creates a (deep) clone of the object. May also return the object directly if the object is
119   * immutable. Default implementation throws CloneNotSupportedException. Typically this should be
120   * implemented by implementing clone() on the object itself, and calling it from here.
121   *
122   * @param obj object to clone
123   * @return Clone of object (if immutable, may be same object)
124   * @throws CloneNotSupportedException if clone not supported
125   */
126  default T clone(T obj) throws CloneNotSupportedException {
127    throw new CloneNotSupportedException();
128  }
129
130  /**
131   * Loops over all protobuf descriptors including nested/referenced descriptors.
132   *
133   * @param exists function that returns false if fn should be called for the given type string
134   * @param fn function to call for each descriptor
135   */
136  default void forEachDescriptor(Predicate<String> exists, BiConsumer<String, byte[]> fn) {
137    forEachDescriptorImpl(getDescriptor().getFile(), exists, fn);
138  }
139
140  private static void forEachDescriptorImpl(
141      FileDescriptor desc, Predicate<String> exists, BiConsumer<String, byte[]> fn) {
142    String name = "proto:" + desc.getFullName();
143    if (exists.test(name)) {
144      return;
145    }
146    for (FileDescriptor dep : desc.getDependencies()) {
147      forEachDescriptorImpl(dep, exists, fn);
148    }
149    fn.accept(name, desc.toProtoBytes());
150  }
151
152  /**
153   * Unpack a serialized protobuf array message.
154   *
155   * @param <T> object type
156   * @param <MessageType> element type of the protobuf array
157   * @param msg protobuf array message
158   * @param proto protobuf implementation
159   * @return Deserialized array
160   */
161  static <T, MessageType extends ProtoMessage<MessageType>> T[] unpackArray(
162      RepeatedMessage<MessageType> msg, Protobuf<T, MessageType> proto) {
163    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
164    T[] result = (T[]) Array.newInstance(proto.getTypeClass(), msg.length());
165    for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
166      result[i] = proto.unpack(msg.get(i));
167    }
168    return result;
169  }
170
171  /**
172   * Unpack a serialized protobuf double array message.
173   *
174   * @param msg protobuf double array message
175   * @return Deserialized array
176   */
177  static double[] unpackArray(RepeatedDouble msg) {
178    double[] result = new double[msg.length()];
179    for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
180      result[i] = msg.get(i);
181    }
182    return result;
183  }
184
185  /**
186   * Unpack a serialized protobuf array message to a list.
187   *
188   * @param <T> object type
189   * @param <MessageType> element type of the protobuf array
190   * @param msg protobuf array message
191   * @param proto protobuf implementation
192   * @return Deserialized list
193   */
194  static <T, MessageType extends ProtoMessage<MessageType>> List<T> unpackList(
195      RepeatedMessage<MessageType> msg, Protobuf<T, MessageType> proto) {
196    ArrayList<T> result = new ArrayList<>(msg.length());
197    for (var item : msg) {
198      result.add(proto.unpack(item));
199    }
200    return result;
201  }
202
203  /**
204   * Pack a serialized protobuf array message.
205   *
206   * @param <T> object type
207   * @param <MessageType> element type of the protobuf array
208   * @param msg protobuf array message
209   * @param arr array of objects
210   * @param proto protobuf implementation
211   */
212  static <T, MessageType extends ProtoMessage<MessageType>> void packArray(
213      RepeatedMessage<MessageType> msg, T[] arr, Protobuf<T, MessageType> proto) {
214    msg.clear();
215    msg.reserve(arr.length);
216    for (var obj : arr) {
217      proto.pack(msg.next(), obj);
218    }
219  }
220
221  /**
222   * Pack a serialized protobuf double array message.
223   *
224   * @param msg protobuf double array message
225   * @param arr array of objects
226   */
227  static void packArray(RepeatedDouble msg, double[] arr) {
228    msg.clear();
229    msg.reserve(arr.length);
230    msg.addAll(arr);
231  }
232
233  /**
234   * Pack a serialized protobuf array message to a list.
235   *
236   * @param <T> object type
237   * @param <MessageType> element type of the protobuf array
238   * @param msg protobuf array message
239   * @param list list of objects
240   * @param proto protobuf implementation
241   */
242  static <T, MessageType extends ProtoMessage<MessageType>> void packList(
243      RepeatedMessage<MessageType> msg, List<T> list, Protobuf<T, MessageType> proto) {
244    msg.clear();
245    msg.reserve(list.size());
246    for (var obj : list) {
247      proto.pack(msg.next(), obj);
248    }
249  }
250}
